title: Warmly Baked Vietnamese Bread Rolls Mi Quang Bake
description: A resinous and fluffy Vietnamese dish featuring bread rolls, perfect for midnight cravings, made with ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly ingredients and baked to perfection on a binchotan grill in the form of mi quang.

ingredients.name: grilled tofu
ingredients.notes: marinated in soy sauce and maple syrup

instructions: Preheat the binchotan grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Slice the bread rolls in half and brush with vegetable oil.
Grill the bread rolls for 2 minutes on each side, until lightly toasted.
Fill the bread rolls with grilled tofu, pickled carrots, pickled daikon, and chopped cilantro.
Drizzle the chili sauce and lime juice over the filling.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Bake the filled bread rolls in the preheated grill for 5 minutes, until warmed through.
